emergencyTerrainFreeze.rule: Do not replace or modify the deployed visible terrain until a genuine human-authored DCC terrain asset has passed sculpt, retopology, UV, material, LOD, integration, performance, and art review.

protectedGameplaySnapshot.algorithm: sha256(stable-json({spawn, exitTransition, gameplayPlane, groundProfile, pits, safeLandingZones, platforms, blocks, enemyAnchors, camera}))
protectedGameplaySnapshot.purpose: DCC terrain work must leave this fingerprint unchanged.

collisionMaster.modificationPolicy: frozen; change only to correct a verified gameplay defect

invariants: The deployed browser-visible terrain remains exactly at commit 55cd085 until approved DCC art replaces it.
Terrain_Visible_Master remains an empty handoff target and 90_EXPORT_VISIBLE remains empty until genuine DCC art exists.
No generated terrain shell, cylinder tree, cube camp, primitive rock mass, or other proxy may be rendered or exported as visible game art.
The collision master is never rendered in normal gameplay and collision debug requires an explicit flag or tool.
The visible master is never a CharacterController, enemy, raycast, or physics collision source.
Visible-terrain edits cannot mutate terrain collision, platform collision, gameplay anchors, checkpoints, cameras, or movement values.
Trees, roots, embedded rocks, foliage, and terrain materials attach only to genuine authored visible art.
Collision and future visible terrain are separate assets and separate Unity hierarchies.
